message: lambda w: f"Heavy rainfall of {w['rainfall']}mm threatens waterlogging."
recommendation:
1. Open all drainage channels immediately.
2. Do not apply fertiliser for 48h after rain.
3. Check field bunds for overflow points.

message: lambda w: f"Moderate rainfall of {w['rainfall']}mm may cause waterlogging."
recommendation: 1. Check drainage. 2. Monitor for root rot. 3. Delay fertiliser application.

message: lambda w: f"Very high humidity ({w['humidity']}%) creates ideal conditions for blight and mildew."
recommendation:
1. Apply Mancozeb 75WP at 2g/litre.
2. Spray early morning before 8 AM.
3. Repeat every 7 days while humidity stays high.
4. Avoid overhead irrigation.

message: lambda w: f"Elevated humidity ({w['humidity']}%) may promote fungal disease."
recommendation:
1. Monitor leaves closely every 2 days.
2. Keep prophylactic fungicide ready.
3. Maintain plant spacing for air circulation.

message: lambda w: f"Extreme temperature of {w['temperature']}°C can damage flowers and reduce yield."
recommendation:
1. Irrigate at 5–7 AM only — never in afternoon heat.
2. Apply mulch to retain soil moisture.
3. Consider shade nets for vegetables.
4. Delay fertiliser application.

message: lambda w: f"High temperature of {w['temperature']}°C may stress crops during flowering."
recommendation:
1. Ensure adequate soil moisture.
2. Avoid pesticide spraying between 11 AM and 4 PM.

message: lambda w: f"Temperature of {w['temperature']}°C risks frost damage to seedlings tonight."
recommendation:
1. Cover seedlings with plastic sheets or dry leaves tonight.
2. Light irrigation before sunset raises soil temperature.
3. Do not apply any chemicals before frost.

message: lambda w: f"Cool temperature of {w['temperature']}°C will slow growth and germination."
recommendation:
1. Delay sowing by 1–2 weeks if temperature stays below 10°C.
2. Apply potassium-rich fertiliser for cold hardening.
3. Mulch around seedlings.

message: lambda w: f"Strong winds of {w['windSpeed']} km/h may lodge and damage standing crops."
recommendation:
1. Install windbreakers on the exposed side of the field.
2. Stake or support tall plants immediately.
3. Harvest mature crops early if wind is forecast for 2+ days.

message: lambda w: f"Moderate winds of {w['windSpeed']} km/h expected."
recommendation:
1. Avoid pesticide and fertiliser spraying — it will drift.
2. Check plant supports.
